title.en: Which machine mixes and pumps when the grid is absent?
title.zh: 没有电网时，哪台机器能搅拌并泵送？

description.en: The diesel mixer: 4108 diesel 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, 23 MPa. Fine-stone distance 100 / 300 m, 13 mm stone 60 / 180 m, 24 mm stone 40 / 120 m.

h1.en: Which machine mixes and pumps when the grid is absent?
h1.zh: 没有电网时，哪台机器能搅拌并泵送？

directAnswer.en: The Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints mix-and-pump and rural or self-built pouring on this diesel unit: 4108 engine 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³. The stone rows are 100 / 300 m for the ≤ 1 inch fine-stone line, 60 / 180 m for 13 mm stone and 40 / 120 m for 24 mm stone. Weight is 4200 kg. It is not a mixing plant and not the electric mixer.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机。邢台河北品锦机械在这台柴油设备上印了搅拌加泵送，以及农村或自建房浇筑：4108 发动机 66–75 kW、25 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³。石子行是 ≤ 1 英寸细石 100 / 300 m，13 mm 石子 60 / 180 m，24 mm 石子 40 / 120 m。重量 4200 kg。它不是搅拌站，也不是电动搅拌泵。

heading.en: Read the stone row before 100 / 300 m
heading.zh: 在用 100 / 300 m 之前先读石子行

body.en: The long pair is the fine-stone line the English table marks as ≤ 1 inch and the Chinese table marks as fine stone. 13 mm is 60 / 180 m. 24 mm is 40 / 120 m. The electric mixer prints one distance, 100 m / 300 m, and aggregate 4 cm and below, on 45 kW + 14 kW. Do not paste the electric aggregate cell onto every diesel stone row.
body.zh: 较长的那一对是英文表标成 ≤ 1 英寸、中文表标成细石的那一行。13 mm 是 60 / 180 m。24 mm 是 40 / 120 m。电动搅拌泵只印一段距离 100 m / 300 m，骨料 4 cm 及以下，电机是 45 kW + 14 kW。不要把电动的骨料格贴到柴油的每一行石子上。

heading.en: A pump that does not mix stays a pump

body.en: If the concrete arrives ready to place, you do not need this 4200 kg mixer. Off-grid placement alone is Diesel 30–120 or the compact rural machines. The diesel mixer’s series note mentions 30, 40 and 50 mixer pairings; this page does not add outputs beyond the printed 25 m³/h row.
body.zh: 如果混凝土到达时已经可以浇筑，就不需要这台 4200 kg 的搅拌泵。单纯的无电网浇筑是柴油30–120或紧凑农村机器。柴油搅拌泵的系列说明提到 30、40、50 的搅拌配置；本页不在已印的 25 m³/h 行之外再加输送量。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Name the stone row: fine stone / ≤ 1 inch, 13 mm, or 24 mm. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请点名石子行：细石 / ≤ 1 英寸、13 mm 或 24 mm。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.zh: 66–75 kW 是一个发动机区间吗？

answer.en: The cell is printed as 4108 / 66–75 kW. Do not split it into extra models on this page.
answer.zh: 这一格印的是 4108 / 66–75 kW。不要在本页再拆成更多型号。

question.en: Is 25 m³/h the same as Diesel 40?

answer.en: Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h and does not mix. This machine prints 25 m³/h and does mix and pump.
answer.zh: 柴油40印的是 26 m³/h，而且不搅拌。这台机器印的是 25 m³/h，并且搅拌并泵送。

question.en: Are the H/V labels 100 horizontal and 300 vertical?
question.zh: 水平/垂直是水平 100、垂直 300 吗？

answer.en: The electric mixer labels 100 m / 300 m as horizontal / vertical. The diesel mixer’s fine-stone cell is printed as 100 / 300 m on the H / V row. Keep that order unless the page you are reading labels it differently, and do not swap in the 24 mm pair.
answer.zh: 电动搅拌泵把 100 m / 300 m 标成水平/垂直。柴油搅拌泵的细石格在水平/垂直行上印的是 100 / 300 m。除非你正在看的页面标法不同，保持这个顺序，并且不要换成 24 mm 那一对。
